title: Paranormal filmmaking in CT: ParaConn vets bring 2 new terrifying films for Halloween 2026
excerpt: Three individuals in Connecticut’s paranormal scene are bringing a pair of movies into the spotlight this Halloween.
content:
Three individuals in Connecticut’s paranormal scene are bringing a pair of movies into the spotlight this Halloween, according to the filmmakers.

“Charles Rosenay, Nick Grossmann, and Doug Palmato are heavy hitters of the scene, famously known for starting the first three ParaConns in Ansonia—a paranormal convention featuring TV celebrities and eerie themes alike, including guests such as John Zaffis, nephew of the legendary Ed Warren,” according to the filmmakers.

Psychic medium explains why he makes house calls in Connecticut. ‘It’s a gift,’ he says.

“After a period of time taking different roads—Rosenay diving into events and acting, Grossmann focusing on intense paranormal filmmaking, and Palmato building his Scared Stiff empire—these creators have taken separate pilgrimages,” they said in a statement. “Miraculously, they are coming out this year with two major films.”

CT brewery expands into a new town. Now they’ve got ‘a huge outdoor space’, more than 4x the production

The first film, Halloween Candy 2, comes from Scared Stiff TV, according to the statement. Its first iteration landed over a million views; you can check out the trailer for its second installment below:

The second film is Expedition Hell: Mark of the Witch, which “capturing a paranormal adventure turned inter-dimensional from a grueling 6-year investigation by CTPASTS (Jeff Gerry) and Ghost Storm (Nick Grossmann),” according to a statement. Take a peek, if you dare, at the trailer:

If you need something to hold you over, Grossmann has also teamed up with the Exorcist Steve Biff Saunders for the gripping documentary series Angel vs. Demons,” according to the filmmakers.

“Following the strong launches of Episode 1 and Episode 2, the series pulls back the veil on the eternal struggle between light and darkness, taking viewers deep into raw spiritual warfare and extraordinary metaphysical phenomena.”
